notes.title: Toy Tactics Release
notes.content:
Dear community,

After eight years, yes eight, in development, Toy Tactics has been released. 

[previewyoutube=OOgo8R1bAGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Toy Tactics is an RTS where you can draw your formation. Play with five armies, strategize to solve tactical puzzles, defend from the Dragur, and conquer all battles.

The game has:

 20 hours of gameplay
 Sandbox, Squirmish and Mercenaries mode
 Online Co-Op and 1vs1


The game has a 30% Launch Discount. Buy it now!

The Joystick Ventures Team 
xoxo

notes.title: Patch update notes for version 1.0.63
notes.content:
Greetings! 
A new patch is now live addressing some minor bugs, 
localization fixes for asian languages and a new skip game feature for some of the minigames - The tree checkers and the Crabs Connect four game.

Enjoy playing!
HJ Team

notes.title: First Patch!
notes.content:
Changes:
- Traditional Chinese support for the keys remapping screen

Bug fixes:
- Update to the save system that caused a few players to lose some progress (sorry about that!)
- Some minor audio and visual fixes

Thanks for getting Lost in Play! 

The Happy Juice Team

notes.title: Lost in Play is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi Friends!
It’s finally time! Thank you for all your patience and support.

LOST IN PLAY IS OUT ON PC!

[previewyoutube=HDwRZXgKmec;full][/previewyoutube]
We can’t thank you enough of all the love and support over the years and even more so up until this day. We’ve worked very hard to bring this adventure to you and can’t wait for you to join Toto and Gal! Join our official Lost in Play Discord Server if you want to share your experience, need help solving puzzles, or just want to say hello!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1328840/Lost_in_Play/
Thank you for coming on this journey with us. Time to get Lost in Play!

notes.title: Lost in Play is releasing on August 10th!
notes.content:
That’s right! Our launch date is official!
In case you missed our worldwide announcement of the release date during the Future Games Show, we are excited to share that Lost in Play is officially launching on Steam on August 10th! We even have a brand new trailer that will take you on a mini-adventure. See it for yourself on YouTube:

[previewyoutube=3SouIxxxR4Q;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been a while since we first announced our whimsical point-and-click adventure game, and we are so happy we can share it with all of you soon. We are so grateful for your support of Lost in Play and this journey is so meaningful because of each of you. A big “Thank You” from the bottom of our hearts!

We can’t wait for you to get Lost in Play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37889985/99a7d15bc0bcf4867b5b0d05cee095c6683878a8.gif

Don't forget to Wishlist Lost in Play on Steam if you want to get notified on launch day! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1328840/Lost_in_Play/
